name: Lone Star Saloon

access.summary: N Judah to Civic Center, then 12 Folsom-Pacific or 19 Polk + short walk
access.detail: From 21st Ave & Judah take the N Judah inbound to Civic Center, then transfer to the 12 Folsom-Pacific (or 19 Polk) toward SoMa and exit near Harrison & 10th; 1354 Harrison St is a short walk. Roughly 40 minutes end to end.

source.label: Official Lone Star Saloon site
source.quote: 1354 Harrison St, San Francisco, CA 94103 — Mon-Sat 4p-2a / Sun 2p-2a

flags: Long-running leather/bear bar; 21+ with ID. Hours are published as a single weekly block, so confirm on the site or by phone before a late trip.

verification.method: Official venue site checked on 2026-09-06 for address and the published weekly hours block; Friday, Saturday and Sunday all close at 2:00 AM.

name: Escape From New York Pizza — Haight

access.detail: From 21st Ave & Judah, the 7 Haight-Noriega runs directly along Haight Street to 1737 Haight (about 30 minutes). Alternatively take the N Judah to Carl & Cole and transfer to the 43 Masonic.

source.label: Official Escape From New York Pizza locations page

flags: Slice counter, cash-friendly walk-up; only Friday and Saturday clear the 11 PM threshold — weeknights close at 11 PM.

verification.method: Official site location listing checked on 2026-09-06 for the Haight Street address, phone and the Friday/Saturday 1:30 AM close.

name: Escape From New York Pizza — Downtown

access.summary: N Judah to Montgomery, then walk
access.detail: Take the N Judah inbound from 21st Ave & Judah to Montgomery Station, then walk about four blocks up Bush Street to 333 Bush. The 30 Stockton and 45 Union-Stockton also stop within a couple of blocks. About 35 minutes total.

source.label: Official Escape From New York Pizza locations page
source.quote: 333 Bush Street #104 … Thursday 10:30a - 1:00a / Friday 10:30a - 2:00a / Saturday 5:00p - 2:00a / Sunday 5:00p - 1:00a — (415) 421-0700

flags: Downtown lobby storefront that opens late only Thursday through Sunday; Saturday and Sunday do not open until 5 PM.

verification.method: Official site location listing checked on 2026-09-06 for the Bush Street address, phone and per-day late-night hours.

name: Shotwell's

access.summary: N Judah to Church, then 22 Fillmore or 33 Ashbury-18th
access.detail: From 21st Ave & Judah take the N Judah to Church & Duboce, then the 22 Fillmore toward the Mission and exit near 18th & Mission; walk to 20th & Shotwell. The 14 Mission and 49 Van Ness-Mission also serve Mission Street nearby. About 45 minutes.

source.label: Official Shotwell's site
source.quote: 3349 20th St, San Francisco, CA 94110 — Sunday – Wednesday 3:30 p.m. – 11:30 p.m. / Thursday – Saturday 3:30 p.m. – 12:00 a.m.

flags: Sunday and Monday–Wednesday close at 11:30 PM, only just past the 11 PM threshold. The bar explicitly states it cannot accommodate big groups.

verification.method: Official venue site checked on 2026-09-06 for the address and the published day-range hours; Friday/Saturday close at midnight and Sunday at 11:30 PM.
